answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: The layer-2 spike of 61.9 sits inside the system-prompted range (31.7 – 64.0), while quantized (0.8 – 2.8) and fine-tuned (0.7 – 6.1) are far below it. The onset layer of 8 matches system-prompted (7 – 8). Relative L2 climbs steeply from 0.146 at layer 1 to a plateau of 0.479 at layer 16 and 0.503 at layer 32, which also fits system-prompted. Final cosine 0.847, effective rank 2.81 and direction consistency 0.538 are all close to the system-prompted ranges, and the final-layer jump of +0.036 fits too. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the huge spike and the 0.538 direction consistency, which is below its 0.618 – 0.705 range. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger L2 values and lower cosine. Layer-1 L2 and the mid-layer size ratio (0.971) are slightly outside the documented ranges, but this is a single draw. Output and logit levels were not measured.
